Hours and recordings per pair

Female with PDMale with PDFemale ControlMale Control

Hours of target-speaker audio per participant, one row per PD–Control pair (pairs 1–15 male, 16–30 female). PD participants contribute 64.96 h and Control participants 73.68 h. Hover a bar for the pair total.

ShowOrder by

Audio per pair ranges from 1.4 h (pair 11) to 10.4 h (pair 24), which reflects data availability at the time of dataset curation. Only 10 of 30 pairs fall within 3–5 h, around the 4.6 h mean.

Each point is one participant, and the curve is a kernel density estimate of these ages.

Profession by diagnostic group

Female with PDMale with PDFemale ControlMale Control

13 categories, sorted by total. Overlapping points indicate equal counts. In points with both sexes, the solid wedge is the female share.

Race by participant pair

One square per participant, by sex and diagnostic group. Mirrored squares are PD–Control partners, who share race in 28 of 30 pairs.

Nationality by participant pair

One square per participant, by sex and diagnostic group. Mirrored squares are PD–Control partners, who share nationality in 16 of 30 pairs.

Recording timeline by participant pair

Each point is one recording, placed by its year relative to baseline: −3 is three years before, +3 three years after. Baseline is the reported year of diagnosis for each PD patient and, for each Control, the year of diagnosis of their matched PD partner (Control row n with PD row n). Pairs 1–15 are male and 16–30 are female.
